name: Bunker vs Verity
desc:
🛡️ BUNKER VS VERITY! 👹

Build. Fortify. Survive.

🧱 Fortify your bunker with tons of different blocks
🔫 Place and CONTROL powerful turrets
👹 Fight off endless waves of Verities
💰 Earn coins from defeating enemies
⚙️ Upgrade your bunker and defenses
🚪 Hide underground when things get crazy
🏆 See how many waves you can survive!

The longer you survive, the harder the Verities become.

Can you build the ultimate bunker and survive the Verity invasion?

👍 LIKE + ⭐ FAVORITE for more updates!
